title: The Golden Thread 2: A Fiber Arts Exhibition
description: Presented by BravinLee Programs, The Golden Thread II brought together the work of 60 artists exploring the possibilities of fiber and textile-based practices. Installed across four floors of a historic warehouse in New York’s South Street Seaport, the exhibition examined how traditional textile techniques can be transformed into contemporary forms of artistic expression. Through my work with woven and knotted industrial cordage, I explore the relationship between material, structure, and physical tension, pushing the boundaries between textile, painting, and sculpture. Together, the works in the exhibition highlight the expressive and sculptural potential of fiber, connecting histories of craft and labor with contemporary approaches to material experimentation.
